slides.headline: We asked AI to edit our podcast. *Here's what happened.*

slides.title: Attempt 1: let the agent click
slides.subtitle: Codex + computer use in *Descript*.
slides.body: Quinn wrote down his editing process and let Codex drive Descript. It did a decent job, but it was sloppy and burned far more Descript credits than editing by hand.

graphic.label: of his Descript credits, gone. The video *missed the mark*.

graphic.text: I could have just done this in *Descript*.

slides.title: Show, don't tell
slides.subtitle: Examples beat *one-shot* prompts.
slides.body: Give the agent videos you like, name what makes them work, and save each style as a reusable skill. Then iterate, like you would with a new editor.

graphic.label: filler words and stutters cut from *one episode*.

slides.title: The verdict
slides.subtitle: Don't let agents *click*. Let them *build*.
slides.body: An agent clicking through an editing app is slow and costly. An agent writing a repeatable pipeline, with a human making the calls, turned one recording into an episode, shorts and these slides.
